# SurfaceGuard 0.5.0

SurfaceGuard 0.5.0 adds static Astro artifact support and closes fail-open resource,
encoding, and report-limit paths.

The Astro adapter derives routes from produced HTML and classifies JavaScript in default
or customized asset directories without reading source routes. Automatic detection
requires produced HTML plus Astro's default `_astro/` directory; customized layouts can
select the adapter explicitly.

Finding limits now cap retained details without capping failure evaluation. Reports state
finding-detail and text-inspection completeness. Recognized text accepts valid UTF-8 and
BOM-tagged UTF-16LE/BE; ambiguous or unsupported encodings produce `SG1003` while
best-effort matching continues. Malformed percent runs are decoded in linear work with
raw evidence-span mapping preserved, and malformed bytes cannot mask adjacent valid
encoded text.

Artifact enumeration, directory depth, manifest traversal, route evidence, and sitemap
entries have explicit policy ceilings. Sitemap parsing also recognizes numeric XML
character references, and common numbered and index gzip sitemap names are classified
consistently.

The attached package is for direct GitHub installation. This release is not published to
npm or another package registry.
